name: The Scream Queen
blurb: Born to shriek, built to survive.
art: A lanky teenager with a buzzed platinum head and smeared mascara in an oversized sequined prom jacket over ripped jeans, mid-scream in a dramatic backbend, both hands pressed to their cheeks, one knee popped

name: Flashlight Duelist
blurb: Points the light where nobody wants to look.
art: A round-faced teenager with warm brown skin and a high-top fade in a huge flannel shirt and cargo shorts, crouched low in a fencing stance, brandishing a giant chrome flashlight like a sword, one eye squinting

name: Rake-Wielding Neighbor
blurb: Has seen three Halloweens like this.
art: A wiry neighbor in their sixties with close-cropped silver hair and deep brown skin, in a mustard cardigan and orthopedic sneakers, lunging forward with a garden rake raised high overhead like a battle standard

name: The Fainting Goth
art: A soft, curvy teenager with pale freckled skin and long black hair, black lace top, velvet skirt and combat boots, collapsing in a theatrical swoon with one wrist pressed to the forehead and a silver crucifix swinging

name: The Wrench
art: A broad, barrel-chested mechanic in their forties with a shaved head and tattooed forearms, grease-stained coveralls tied at the waist, mid-war-cry with a huge wrench raised in both hands

name: Roller Derby
art: A teenager with big curly puffs of hair and freckles across dark cheeks on rainbow roller skates, spinning on one skate with arms flung wide, glow necklaces whirling, knee pads covered in stickers

name: Wheelie King
blurb: Pops a wheelie into every fight.
art: A grinning teenager with a spiked violet mohawk popping a wheelie in a sticker-covered wheelchair, a baseball bat slung over one shoulder, studded fingerless gloves on the rims

name: Vampire Hunter
blurb: Read every book in the occult aisle.
art: A skinny teenager with thick round glasses and a tucked-in argyle sweater vest leaping into the air, a braid of garlic in one hand and a wooden stake in the other, tie flying over one shoulder

name: The Diva
art: A stocky person with a full black beard, golden glitter eyeshadow and a flowing satin kimono striking a sharp vogue pose, one hand framing the face and the other flaring a lace fan

name: The Goalie
art: A tall, muscular teenager with short copper curls in a varsity jacket and knee socks, braced in a low athletic crouch with a field hockey stick, teeth bared in a fierce grin

name: The Night Librarian
art: A plump middle-aged person with a sleek gray bob and reading glasses on a beaded chain, holding up a thick library book like a shield and hopping backward with one leg kicked up in comic fright

name: The Stage Diver
art: A teenager with a tall green liberty-spike mohawk and a studded denim vest caught mid-air in a stage dive, arms spread wide, an electric guitar strapped across their back, sneakers kicking

name: The Prep
art: A teenager with a glossy black bob and a popped pink polo collar recoiling in an exaggerated shriek, gripping a tennis racket in both hands like a bat, sweater tied around their shoulders

name: Pizza Runner
blurb: Thirty minutes or the monster is free.
art: A lanky twenty-something with long braids under a red delivery cap sprinting mid-stride, a tower of pizza boxes balanced up to the chin, one sneaker flying off

name: Cheer Captain
blurb: Gives the whole crew a spirit boost.
art: A stocky teenager with a sweep of dark hair in a maroon and gold cheer uniform frozen at the top of a high kick, pom-poms thrown up like fireworks, a megaphone at their feet

name: The Magician
blurb: Knows a trick for every terror.
art: A small, elderly stage magician with a pencil mustache and a sequined cape flinging a fan of playing cards into the air with a dramatic flourish, a white rabbit peeking out of their top hat
